Product details

A Little Christmas Magic, All in One Cube

Turn any corner of your home into a cozy Christmas wonderland with GlowCube™. Inside its beautiful amber-tinted transparent cube, a charming winter scene comes to life with Santa Claus figures, a cheerful snowman, snow-covered miniature trees, and a warm festive glow.

Its layered, mirror-like appearance creates a captivating sense of depth, giving the miniature Christmas world a beautiful 3D effect. Whether placed on a desk, bedside table, mantelpiece, or holiday display, GlowCube™ adds a magical touch to your seasonal decorations.

Looking for a thoughtful Christmas gift? This charming decorative lamp makes a lovely seasonal surprise for friends, family, or anyone who loves the magic of Christmas.

A DIY kit. GlowCube™ arrives as a kit that you put together yourself, and it is powered by USB (5V). The photos show the finished, assembled cube.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What is GlowCube™?
GlowCube™ is a decorative Christmas lamp: a transparent, amber-tinted acrylic cube holding a miniature winter scene with Santa Claus figures, a snowman, snowy ground, small snow-covered trees and warm LED lights. It is sold as a DIY kit, so you assemble it yourself.
How does the 3D mirror effect work?
The cube's reflective, mirror-like surfaces repeat the scene inside it, which makes the miniature world look deeper and more layered than it is.
Does the lamp come with batteries or a power adapter?
GlowCube™ is powered through a USB interface at 5V, so it does not use batteries. The package contains one decoration; a USB power source or cable is not listed as included.
How large is the product?
Once assembled, GlowCube™ measures about 12 × 12 × 12 cm, small enough for a desk, bedside table or shelf. The package it arrives in measures 15 × 15 × 5 cm.
Do I need to assemble it?
Yes. GlowCube™ is a DIY kit, so you put the scene together yourself. The photos show the finished, assembled cube. Assembly takes about 3–5 minutes. Add whether instructions are included and whether any glue or tools are needed.
What is it made of and what's in the package?
GlowCube™ is made of plastic. The package contains one decoration kit (the material package) for one GlowCube™.
How long does shipping take?
Estimated delivery time is 7–14 days. See the Shipping Policy.
What is your return policy?
Read the full Returns & Refunds Policy.
How can I contact customer support?
Email us at add support email with your order number if you have one. Our support hours are 12:00–20:00 (European time), and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
